name: DIP double router transfer
summary: DIP._transfer executes the base transfer twice when either endpoint is the router. Skimming excess DIP to the router debited the pair twice; sync committed the reduced reserve, allowing the attacker to exchange remaining DIP for almost all AIC. The same deployer's NEX tokens, the same template, were drained the same way.
notes: Exact AIC depletion of pair 0xf7d8267d01d1104da2dd30828aa9c0e1647919ef excludes the attacker-supplied 19000000 AIC swap input. Valuation applies the same-transaction realised price: 9977659.001700876485419035 AIC sold for 111097.596667856001191208 USDC, valued at par. The remaining 60000 AIC paid as financing cost stays in gross loss and is estimated at that effective price. DIP shifted to the router is not valued separately; gas and financing do not reduce gross loss.

Campaign: deployer 0x13b81c2e's NEX tokens 0xe75b76f2 and 0xae04ae29 carry the same router branch; their AIC pairs 0xf8331a89 and 0x974c0078 were drained by skim to the router (0x85455cb4, 0x905cc861, other attackers). Their AIC is valued at what each attacker realised selling it, 320.076002 and 21503.921644 USDC; NEX moved to the router or fee address is not valued. The DeFiHackLabs AIC PoC's fee-on-transfer explanation does not match the trace.
